Services

Every project is scoped from an itemized task list and quoted flat before anything starts. Published figures are starting points, not packages.

How it works

From first call to launch day.

  1. 01

    Free review & call

    Start with a free review of the site you have now, or a call. Scope, price and timeline land in writing before anything is signed.

  2. 02

    Design & build

    Custom-coded to current standards — semantic HTML, mobile-first CSS, WCAG 2.2 AA — with preview links as it takes shape.

  3. 03

    Launch

    A final accessibility and performance pass, then launch, with a 7–14 day post-launch warranty.

  4. 04

    Keep it running

    Website management at $99 a month, cancel anytime with 30 days’ notice, or call when you need support.

Fixed-fee projects 50% at kickoff · 25% at design approval · 25% at launch

Your domain. Your hosting. Your files. In your name from day one.

Everything is set up in your name from the start. If you ever move on, you take all of it with you — no gatekeeping, no ticket queue between you and your own website.
